surprises: THE COLLAPSE IS NOW VENDOR-CORROBORATED, not merely ruled: BD's own account-level MV (fact_allocations Account Market Value) ties the COLLAPSED sum on 888 of 925 accounts at 1bp with ZERO unexplained variances -- and on the dual-relationship specimen z0927448821 it equals the collapsed $205,070.77 exactly (naive would serve $410,141.54). The vendor itself collapses relationship grain in its account-level number.
The live double-count delta is EXACTLY the DC1-measured figure: $205,070.77, to the cent, on the same account the 08-04 ruling measured (z0927448821, two LP assets under two relationships).

The COT spec's OPEN cell #2 (no account-level authoritative total measured) is now PARTIALLY CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT: fact_allocations carries Account Market Value at rest, 889 of 925 boundary accounts covered, same-vintage with custody. Consumed as B_03's tie per the spec's fallback clause; whether it becomes B_00's AUTHORITATIVE source is RECON-5a's ruled event, explicitly not decided here.

36 boundary accounts carry ALL-ROWS-NULL custody value (V(t)=NULL served, never $0) and 37 lack the independent roster surface -- 36 of the 37 are the same accounts (the null class is also the roster-absent class), 1 OK-valued account is simply unrostered.

Zero decomposition deviations at the position level (12,611/12,611) AND the account level (889/889): the vendor's in-row MV = UMV + Accrual identity is exact across the whole book -- B_02's RAW-IN-ROW verdict rests on measurement, not schema trust.

TRANSPOSABILITY TALLY, BOTH FRAMES per CTO ruling: rows-verbatim ~78% (b03 ~75%, b00 ~70%, b01 ~85%, b02 ~30% -- the verdict artifact is COT-novel in content, INF-shaped in form; the B-group inherits the A-group harness so structure dominates) BESIDE judgment-calls-diverged 31% (4 of 13 rows rest on a COT-specific call). The 5 calls, named: (1) fair_value = market_value with accrual EMBEDDED (never re-added -- the INF/49F fair_value=X+accrued identity does not transpose because cot's MV already contains accrual); (2) the roster Account Market Value consumed as B_03's independent tie (the OPEN-cell fallback exercised); (3) NO-INDEPENDENT-SURFACE minted as a recon_status member (neither sibling needed it); (4) value_status ALL-ROWS-NULL minted (cot's real-null class; INF's zero-coercion classes do not transpose -- cot ships REAL nulls, not coerced zeros); (5) B_01 passthrough keeps VENDOR grain with the collapse contract on the manifest rather than collapsing (the passthrough-vs-gateway split). Curve check: 62% -> 78% matches ~A's 64% -> 79% almost exactly.
